title: DropChain Marketplace to Launch on June 14th
summary: DropChain Marketplace to launch June 14th. The marketplace increases accessibility with credit cards and crypto crypto checkout. No Gas Fees, KYC, or Wallet are needed.
author: Nathaniel Thoreson
body:
At DropChain, it's our mission to enable builders to easily create user-friendly web3 products. Today, we're excited to announce a significant stride toward that mission. On June 14th, the DropChain Marketplace will officially launch!

The marketplace has been meticulously designed to demolish the knowledge barriers that have restricted the masses from creating and joining NFT communities. It's no secret, 2023 has not been kind to the web3 ecosystem. Our aim is to breathe new life into the world of digital collectibles on the Algorand blockchain by ushering in a new wave of builders and users.

‍

Making NFTs Accessible

Entering the world of NFTs is no easy task. For most, the hassle, risk, and frustration aren't worth it. The process of creating a wallet, KYC, transferring tokens, and connecting a wallet is a tedious and anxiety-provoking process for even seasoned traders. It's no surprise that the vast majority of the population is at best skeptical and at worst fearful of NFTs and web3. The DropChain marketplace is here to change that.

Payment Inclusivity with Credit Cards and Crypto

At DropChain, accessibility is our top priority. To cater to a wide range of buyers, the DropChain Marketplace supports both credit card and popular cryptocurrency payments (BTC, ETH,USDC, and more) via Coinbase Commerce. This flexibility allows individuals with varying preferences and expertise levels to participate in the NFT market with ease.

Streamlined Wallet Generation for Effortless Onboarding

Wallets are a critical pillar for any blockchain ecosystem. Without a wallet, you're like an international traveler who lost your passport. However, creating and managing web3 wallets can be overwhelming, especially for newcomers to the crypto space. DropChain eliminates these challenges by automatically generating wallets for users when they complete their first purchase on the DropChain Marketplace.

The DropChain Single Sign-On allows anyone to create a DropChain Wallet with just a Google account. Users can generate and access this digital wallet in a single click — no web3 knowledge required.
